integration_removed.description:
The Eight Sleep integration has been removed from __HA_KEEP__.

The Eight Sleep API has changed and now requires a unique secret which is inaccessible outside of their apps.

To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) integration entries from your __HA_KEEP__ setup. [View your existing Eight Sleep integration entries]({entries}).
integration_removed.title: The Eight Sleep integration has been removed
